recommendation_summary: Set up a single hosted heartbeat monitor (Healthchecks.io), pinged by a small cron wrapper around `nightly-sync`, that emails the user when the expected completion signal does not arrive within a grace period.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to hear when `nightly-sync` fails, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and moving everything into Docker for this fix.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends email only if it reaches that step; nothing independently notices a failed or missing run.
labels.Checked myself: From your report: cron runs it at 03:00 on `edna`, and four startup failures produced no notification.

note: The reply recommends one dead-man alert, with the wrapper only sending its signal, and drops central logging and Docker.
